_comment: English is the canonical ModuCPP syntax: its tokens are the ones the lexer, parser and C++ backend actually use, so it has no aliases. Copy this file into a new language folder and fill in 'aliases' to add a syntax language without recompiling the engine. 'position' is "keyword" (default, never matches after '.', '::' or '->') or "member" (only matches there, for built-in API aliases). Set "identifying": false on spellings that are also plausible English identifiers so they translate but never vote in automatic source-language detection. Order matters: when translating INTO this language, the first alias listed for a canonical token is the spelling that gets written.
